# PAYG withholding variation application
## Why vary or reduce withholding amounts
For example, you may want to apply for a variation if the normal rate of withholding leads to a large credit at the end of the income year because your tax-deductible expenses are higher than normal.

You can lodge your application during the year.

## How to lodge your application
- **ATO**
- **Tax**
- **PAYG withholding variation**.

## Instructions for your variation application
### Section C: Rental details
Also refer to [Deductions for vacant land](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/investments-and-assets/property-and-land/land-vacant-land-and-subdividing/deductions-for-vacant-land) to see if the changes in legislation affect deductions you can claim.

### Section E: Annual income and tax offsets
- **ATO**

### Section F: Annual deductions
#### F3 Expenses related to rental property
For more information, refer to [How to claim rental expenses](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/investments-and-assets/property-and-land/residential-rental-properties/rental-expenses/how-to-claim-rental-expenses).

# Varying your PAYG withholding
## On this page
- [Upward variations](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/jobs-and-employment-types/varying-your-payg-withholding#ato-Upwardvariations)

## Downward variations
This reduces the tax withheld from your payments, typically to prevent over-withholding when tax-deductible expenses are higher than normal. Before making a downward variation request you should confirm if your allowance will be fully or partially [deductible](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/income-deductions-offsets-and-records/deductions-you-can-claim).

### Example: downward variation for taxable income
He also owns a rental property and receives rental income.

### Processing times
You need to lodge a [PAYG withholding variation application](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-withholding-variation-application) with us to request a downwards variation.
